verdict.rationale: Honcho's docs say the core is open source on GitHub and can be run entirely on your own infrastructure. The CLI's `honcho start` runs the API, deriver, Postgres and Redis via Docker, and llms.txt describes Honcho as an open-source memory layer. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and in-depth production self-hosting docs (scaling, configuration, upgrades) beyond the local Docker start command.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the memory layer from open-source code (e.g. via Docker) on infrastructure I control

citations.quote: The core is open source at github.com/plastic-labs/honcho, so you can run the whole thing yourself and keep your data on your own infrastructure.
honcho start runs API, deriver, Postgres, and Redis via Docker.
Honcho is an open-source memory layer for AI agents, built by Plastic Labs.
